title: kyllinga umbellata
intro: Kyllinga umbellata, commonly known as the umbrella sedge or umbrella flat sedge, is a type of sedge plant found in various parts of the world. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Kyllinga umbellata include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
